message: No Mails to be sent since Resend configuration is not set
reason: The E2E / deploy-smoke / reference-client stacks deliberately leave mail unconfigured, so the embedded server logs this once at startup (embedded/server.go). It is the expected state for a mail-less install, not a failure; a misconfigured Resend account on a real deployment surfaces through the integration health and delivery rows, not this line.

message: TRUSTED_PROXIES is empty; trusting loopback (127.0.0.1/32, ::1/128) for the bundled nginx. If an external reverse proxy fronts this instance, add its address to TRUSTED_PROXIES — otherwise every client shares the proxy's rate-limit bucket and logged IP.
reason: Every CI stack uses the shipped bundled-nginx deployment, where the only proxy is the loopback nginx and trusting loopback is correct (embedded/server.go). The line is a startup advisory for operators who front the instance with an external proxy; there is no configuration in these stacks that would silence it without diverging from the documented deployment.

The access log (middleware/logging.go) emits a warn/error line only for a 5xx. e2e/immich.spec.ts deliberately configures an unreachable Immich (https://immich.example and http://127.0.0.1:54321) and opens the contact thumbnail and the people picker, so the backend proxies answer EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR/503 and degrade as designed. Those are the only 5xx the suite drives; a regression that produces more trips this bound.

errors.LogError (errors/middleware.go) logs a 5xx at error; the same two deliberately-unreachable-Immich e2e calls (immich.spec.ts) are the only 5xx the E2E suite drives, and each logs once here alongside its access-log line. The bound keeps the gate sensitive to any additional 5xx.

e2e/immich.spec.ts clicks the Settings "Test connection" button with an unreachable https://immich.example; the service logs the ping failure and returns the diagnostic to the caller (the UI is what the test asserts). The same class of user-triggered diagnostic the #1474 triage downgraded elsewhere; bounded to this suite's immich spec.

e2e/meerkatImport.spec.ts feeds a non-Meerkat file and asserts the wizard reports the rejection inline; the controller logs the rejected upload before returning the 4xx. Environment-inherent to the negative test, not a server fault.

e2e/monicaImport.spec.ts submits an unreachable Monica connection and asserts the inline error; the controller logs the client's failed connect before returning the 4xx. Environment-inherent to the negative test.

e2e/notifications.spec.ts exercises the "send test notification" failure path against an unreachable channel; the controller logs the client-triggered test result before returning it. Environment-inherent to the negative test.

message: webhook delivery will not be retried
reason: e2e/systemEvents.spec.ts registers one webhook pointed at a permanent-404 receiver and fires it ~101 times to fill the admin log's 100-row window, so this warn (and the integration_failed system event it records) is raised once per fire. This is the intended, bounded signal that test asserts on; the bound leaves headroom for the one test's full page-fill.
